text: As Texas communities consider major supercomputing investments, careful long-term tax planning is essential. Under Texas’s no-new-revenue tax framework, rising property values generally drive tax rates down. text:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and
zh: OpenAI：公布内部研究新数据，研究人员使用AI呈指数上升，智能体可完成更长任务，但人仍是研究核心，且花在安全上的时间在增加。

text:
A successful stellar merger 🤝

Scientists recently spotted a star slightly less massive than the Sun merging into a puffy supergiant star in the outskirts of the Andromeda galaxy. This hard-to-observe event resulted in a new star nicknamed "Bao."
zh: NASA：在仙女座星系外围观测到一颗略小于太阳的恒星并入膨胀超巨星，合并后的新星被称作“Bao”。

text: Our Hera mission is now studying asteroid Didymos from just 28.5 km away in visible light and infrared to reveal its surface features, composition and temperature. These observations will help us better understand asteroid properties and improve planetary defence.

text:
